setup.command: if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -sSfL https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/dist/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init -o /tmp/rustup-init && chmod +x /tmp/rustup-init && /tmp/rustup-init -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain 1.98.0; fi; if ! command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git-lfs; fi
